## New Investigation Ideas

- **[2026-10-23] The live portfolio still labels Flutter a "🟢 Burry-aligned long", but Burry sold all of it on 09-11.** [[finance/trading-portfolio]]'s Burry-signal table gives FLUT the reason "Burry long at $100.72 (Jul 24 2026); anti-prediction-markets thesis", and the 10-22 briefing kept the last share on Watch with that label. [[finance/investor-letters/source-burry-trading-post-2026-09-11]] says he sold the whole position. His reason was price: it was no longer cheap next to names that had fallen further, and he moved most of the money into LULU under $100. The briefing has not noticed. **Next step:** re-label FLUT in the signal table to "Burry exited 09-11 (valuation, thesis not withdrawn)". Then decide whether the free-ride share still has a reason to be held. Also check [[finance/michael-burry/cross-reference]] for other rows that went stale when he sold. (Only ~€0.89 is at stake. The concern is that briefing labels get copied forward without being checked.)

## New Cross-Domain Connections

- **[2026-10-23] Fred's game already measures "home advantage", and Sports Betting's unread research paper measures the same thing in real leagues.** [[games/terrain-autobattler-map-pipeline]] rejects a map if any faction's win rate is more than 5 points off its pool average over 2,000 fights (D-035). Each faction has a home terrain, so the match map shifts which side is favoured ([[games/terrain-autobattler-factions-units-economy]]). That is a home-advantage test with a significance threshold. [[sports-betting/markets]] lists "public bias toward home teams" as its first edge source but has no way to measure it. The uningested paper `raw/sports-betting/Scoring dynamics across professional team sports tempo, balance and predictability - EPJ Data Science.md` uses the same quantity: "balance" is the share of scoring events each team wins, modelled as a biased Bernoulli process. It finds real NFL/college football games vary more than a fair coin would explain. The harness Fred built for map balance (fixed seeds, per-condition win rate against a baseline, a 5-point rejection gate) is the template for a first Sports Betting model page. It would estimate home bias per league, then check whether bookmaker 1X2 prices over- or under-price it.

## New Investigation Ideas

- **[2026-10-22] Today's podcast pick, Nicolai Tangen's *In Good Company*, already has a 58-minute interview with SAP CEO Christian Klein (30 Apr 2025, "European Tech Leadership, Cloud Innovation, and Performance Culture"). It covers AI's effect on SAP's business model, and nobody has ingested it.** The wiki's SAP coverage is one-sided. [[finance/source-sap-prior-labs-2026]] calls SAP's AI move "thesis-strengthening". The 09-25 thinker entry raised the opposite view: agentic AI could break seat-based HR/ERP software (see [[finance/ideas/idea-wday]]). Nothing has tested either view against what management actually says. The question is live now, because the 10-21 briefing flagged SAP for a free-ride trim and [[finance/models/model-portfolio-management]] still files SAP as 🟢 LOW AI risk inside a grouped "European value" row. *Action:* get the transcript or episode notes (nbim.no/en/news-and-insights/podcast, or Acast "highlights-christian-klein-ceo-of-sap"). Check whether Klein says how SAP will price once AI agents replace user seats, and file the answer as a Finance source page linked from the SAP holding. NBIM is a top SAP shareholder, so this is an owner interviewing management, not a sell-side call. Source: [[podcasts/suggestions]] (week of 2026-10-22).

## New Cross-Domain Connections

- **[2026-10-22] Crypto has no page on hacks or exploits, yet three of Fred's six tokens carry the kind of risk that today's podcast pick, *The Lazarus Heist*, is about.** [[podcasts/suggestions]] (week of 2026-10-22) recommends the BBC series as a follow-on to [[podcasts/podcast-cyberhack-the-conti-files-bbc-episode-6]]. North Korea's Lazarus group has made DeFi bridges, exchanges and pooled-liquidity protocols its main revenue source (Ronin 2022, Bybit 2025). [[crypto/crypto-portfolio]] already records CertiK 3.5/10 for both $LUCKY and $TEST, and $EV is a single unified pool offering 100x leverage. [[crypto/defi-watchlist]] treats "collapse multiple DeFi primitives into one product" as a plus. It never says the same design puts every user's collateral behind one contract, so one exploit takes all of it. The Crypto domain values these tokens on price and tokenomics only; the podcast gives a ready way into the smart-contract and custody risk the domain has never priced. A watchlist "Concepts to Research" line on exploit history and audit status for $EV and SmarDex would close the gap.
